Diablo 4 Paladin Build (Zealous Shredder) Zealot Zeal Build Lord of Hatred Guide
In this Diablo 4 build guide, I'm going to be showing you my Zealous Shredder build. This is a Paladin build that uses that Zealot Oath and the Zeal skill in order to just blend everything up on the screen. It zips around the screen, hitting everything over and over with zeal, just absolutely annihilating it and honestly, I think it has even higher damage potential than the previous Paladin build that I made.
